why_best: Anchoring the text along a receding spatial axis establishes a sleek, monumental sense of scale that turns routine social proof into a high-end visual anchor.
why_bad: A standard horizontal side-scroll across a flat plane would feel like a cheap website banner, stripping away the cinematic grandeur this moment demands.
trap: Reducing the receding foreshortening too much will collapse the spatial illusion into an awkward, squished tilt rather than an infinite horizon.
